title: Activation products eight days after AmBe: activities on 16 June 2023 and which decays could produce an MSSI-like topology
question: Which xenon activation products (125Xe, 125I, 127Xe, 129mXe, 131mXe, 133Xe, 133mXe, 135Xe, 137Xe) were present on 16 June 2023, at what activities normalised through LZ Table I, which decay schemes contain a 12 keV local deposit plus a gamma able to travel >= 20 cm, and what is the expected number of MSSI-like topologies vs LZ's MSSI model and the event?
headline_result: Normalised to LZ's 125I count (8.9 events -> 1200 FV decays/run -> 1.6e4 124Xe captures per calibration), activation yields <= 1.5e-4 MSSI-like events per run and <= 1e-9 within +-1 h of the event: no activation decay deposits 12 keV locally (EC daughters 33.2/4.9 keV -> S2c 20900/5320 vs 9268 phd; isomers deposit everything locally) and every gamma <= 375 keV has P(20 cm) <= 1e-3 (<= 2.6e-2 with a longer attenuation bracket)
model_or_mechanism: captures ~ abundance x sigma (thermal/fast brackets, Table-I-anchored intermediate) for a 1-d AmBe; radioactivedecay Bateman to +8.39 d; 125I/137Cs purification removal (3.6 d); NEST-LZ ER yields for ROI acceptance; recalled XCOM-like attenuation + Klein-Nishina for 20 cm transport and 12 keV Compton; quantised EC/IC local deposits; random-coincidence rate
stance: neutral (tool, projection, or constraint) - closes the activation-MSSI route; does not discriminate DM from other origins
result_type: computed (decay, transport, coincidence) / estimated (capture spectrum, acceptances)
confidence: high - rests on quantised EC/IC deposit energies and exponential attenuation, robust under every bracket (capture spectrum x80, f 0.1-0.3, N_cal 1-3, dt 0.2-1 us, Cs removed/retained, two attenuation tables)
builds_on: LZ arXiv:2609.02823 (Table I, Fig. 2/4 captions, Discussion, supplement MSSI); P004 (neighbourhood MSSI, attenuation), P010 (125I timing, f=0.2, band width), P013
